texts.zh: 自[Root.Target.GetName]发来的报告表明，当地有相当大的风险爆发暴力骚乱。然而，幸亏[Root.Owner.GetAdj]军队迅速而果断地采取了行动，在忠诚的公民们的帮助下，这场威胁得以平息。
texts.en: Reports from [Root.Target.GetName] suggested that there was an imminent risk that violent rioting would break out. However, thanks to the quick and decisive action of [Root.Owner.GetAdj] forces, in partnership with loyalist civilians, this threat has been quelled.
